summary: A multi-organization campaign active from mid-May through early June 2026 in which compromised GitHub Personal Access Tokens were used for repository reconnaissance via the GitHub API, low-volume validation cloning, and highly parallelized mass cloning of private repositories. The actor operated from AWS ca-central-1 infrastructure and a HostPapa IP using the git/2.43.0 and git/2.25.1 user agents, and the source of the leaked PATs was never identified. Detection rests on GitHub audit log events such as git.clone and api.request, anomalous git/Chrome user agents, and the listed source IPs.
